description: Installation of extraction flue system to rear.
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p style="margin-left: 15px;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">Noise arising from the use of the kitchen extractor fan or any associated equipment shall not increase the existing background noise level (LA90 ,15mins) when measured (LAeq,15mins) 1 metre external from the nearest residential or noise sensitive premises. The applicant shall also ensure that vibration/structure borne noise derived from the use of the extractor fan does not cause noise nuisance within residential or noise sensitive premises.</span></p><p style="margin-left: 15px;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">REASON: To safeguard the amenities of neighbouring occupiers.&nbsp;</span></p>

<p><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"></div></p><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><p style="margin-left: 15px;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">The development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the kitchen extraction, odour control measures, and maintenance specifications detailed within the Odour Management Plan (Ref: Delta Tech Ltd, prepared by Miss S. Ingraham, dated Jan 2026). The approved scheme shall be fully implemented prior to the first occupation of the use hereby permitted. Thereafter, the equipment shall be operated and maintained in perpetuity in accordance with the approved maintenance programme to ensure the adequate control of odour emissions.</span></p><p style="margin-left: 15px;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">REASON: To ensure the proposal is served my adequate means of fume extraction and filtration to protect neighbouring amenities.&nbsp;</span></p></div>
